description: Shell script for building, configuring, and running end-to-end tests with Docker for the openclaw onboarding process, including setting up environment, running wizard interactions, and validating configurations.

methods.name: start_gateway
methods.description: Starts the openclaw gateway server in a background node process on port 18789.

methods.name: wait_for_gateway
methods.description: Waits until the gateway server is listening and reachable via a socket connection.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Terminates the gateway process given its PID.

methods.name: run_wizard_cmd
methods.description: Runs a wizard command in a pseudo-interactive environment, manages input/output via FIFO, and optionally handles a gateway process.

methods.name: run_wizard
methods.description: Default wrapper to run the onboarding wizard with specified parameters.

methods.name: make_home
methods.description: Creates temporary directory as a workspace for a test case.

methods.name: set_isolated_openclaw_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables to isolate the openclaw environment to a specific directory.

methods.name: assert_file
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, exits if missing.

methods.name: assert_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists, exits if missing.

methods.name: select_skip_hooks
methods.description: Automates selection in wizard to skip hooks setup.

methods.name: send_local_basic
methods.description: Automates sending inputs for the local basic onboarding flow.

methods.name: send_reset_config_only
methods.description: Automates resetting configuration during onboarding.

methods.name: send_channels_flow
methods.description: Automates configuring channels via wizard.

methods.name: send_skills_flow
methods.description: Automates configuring skills via wizard.

methods.name: run_case_local_basic
methods.description: Runs the full local basic onboarding flow and validates configuration files.

methods.name: run_case_remote_non_interactive
methods.description: Runs remote onboarding flow non-interactively and validates remote config.

methods.name: run_case_reset
methods.description: Runs onboarding with a reset config and validates post-reset config.

methods.name: run_case_channels
methods.description: Runs the channels configuration wizard flow and validates config.

methods.name: run_case_skills
methods.description: Runs the skills configuration wizard flow and validates config.

methods.name: assert_log_not_contains
methods.description: Checks that a log file does not contain a specific string.

methods.name: validate_local_basic_log
methods.description: Ensures logs do not contain certain system messages during local basic run.
